name: crowded_ai_gap_requires_vwap_confirmation
description: Avoiding QCOM after it failed VWAP/range confirmation prevented buying a catalyst gap that later fell below the planned stop reference.
notes: Avoiding QCOM after it failed VWAP/range confirmation prevented buying a catalyst gap; MU was also kept watch-only because VWAP and peer confirmation were not explicit after a parabolic memory-stock move.

name: headline_without_opening_range_hold_is_avoid
description: HOOD had a public restructuring headline but never confirmed constructive opening-range or fintech/crypto risk appetite, so watch-only was correct.
notes: HOOD repeatedly had headline or repair-watch interest but never confirmed constructive opening-range, VWAP, or fintech/crypto risk appetite, so watch-only was correct.

name: industrial_narrative_needs_vwap_hold
description: The Lockheed/defense-supply narrative remains plausible, but today showed it should not be bought unless price holds the entry band with VWAP support.
notes: GM never provided the required entry-band and VWAP hold after the defense-supply headline; avoiding it after the failed range improved the pattern record, but the initial thesis was not strong enough.

name: failed_buy_range_requires_fresh_thesis
description: Once a planned long trades below its buy range or stop reference before entry, it must move to invalidated or repair-watch status until a fresh setup appears.
notes: QCOM, GM, and HOOD all stayed invalidated or repair-watch after failing original buy references; the profile avoided recycling stale longs.

name: action_specific_confidence_needed
description: Monitor confidence must specify whether it refers to entry, avoid, thesis, or data quality so high avoid confidence is not mistaken for bullish conviction.
notes: Late high confidence on 2026-06-16 and 2026-06-17 reflected avoid/watch confidence, while 2026-06-18 introduced clearer action_confidence fields for MU, QCOM, and HOOD.
